metadata.description: An undated document offering scholarships for foreign students includes a handwritten notation for Pres. Upham. It describes a one-year scholarship with possible renewal, room and board, and study in arts and sciences. The document states that students may be selected from China, India, Latin America, Siam, and Japan, and lists Oxford, Ohio, as its address.
metadata.title: Offer of scholarship for foreign student, undated
metadata.transcript:
[page 1]
[handwritten] [underlined: Pres. [President] Upham]

OFFER OF SCHOLARSHIP FOR FOREIGN STUDENT

Plans of college entering citizenship -- ideal university

Address -- Oxford, Ohio

HIGH OPPORTUNITY OFFERED

Scholarship offered to a few students.

Conditions of scholarship -- Room and board including,

Field of study -- Arts and sciences.

One year scholarship with possible renewal.

Student selected -- From China, India, Latin America, Siam, Japan,

No certainty that foreign students will not interfere as American students.

Books and incidental college expenses paid by President Student Government.

Tuition fee waived and boarding furnished -- Foreign Student Committee.

[handwritten] [unclear]
PRESIDENT OF STUDENT'S FOREIGN GOVERNMENT

[handwritten] [unclear]
DIRECTOR OF STUDENT'S FOREIGN ACTIVITIES

[handwritten] [unclear]
FOREIGN PRESIDENT
